_units: volume_l = litres, mass_kg = kilograms, capacity_l = storage added when worn. Plate *_vox sizes are 1 cm voxels. Armor: rating = level on Ballistics.LEVELS; material = ceramic, steel, polyethylene or composite; durability divides the integrity each hit takes (ArmorRules.INTEGRITY_LOSS); plate fits = carrier tiers it fits. Carriers (aramid soft armor): soft_rating, soft_faces (front, back, side), soft_parts (chest, abdomen), spall_cover (neck, face, arms). Magazines name their round in data/rounds.json; muzzle_velocity_mps overrides the round's for that barrel. Medical: treats = wound kinds it fixes, treat_s = seconds to apply (self_mult on yourself), rushed_s / remove_s = a rushed tourniquet and taking one off. Kits (IFAK, trauma kit) hold contents (item id: count); an opened kit keeps what is left in its state. Ammo: magazines and loose rounds (stats.loose) of the same calibre go together; volume_l and mass_kg of loose rounds are per round (packed), a magazine's mass_kg is full and empty_mass_kg empty. Guns: spread_deg is the weapon's own mechanical cone (a player's aim adds the rest: Soldier.SHOOTER_*), ai_spread_deg the cone the AI shoots with (its accuracy as before P0362), rail = it takes an optic (back-up irons with none), optic = the optic it comes with; the weapon's state's optic names the one mounted (empty for none; missing: its own). Optics (type optic, P0362) mount on a rail and go with the gun: view = open (the reticle over an open sight: red dot, holographic) or tube (the scope picture, its eyepiece ring = ring, a share of the screen's height); reticle = dot, holo, lpvo, chevron or mil_dot; dot_moa and ring_moa = a lit dot's and a holographic ring's size; magnification = its power, the lowest of a variable one (1 = none), magnification_max (the mouse wheel zooms), magnification_start; power is against the unaimed view (10x = a tenth of its tangent); magnifier = a flip-up magnifier's power (the magnifier key); bdc = [range m, mils below the aim point] holds; art = its model (VoxelArt). Smoke grenades name their cloud colour in smoke_colour (SmokeCloud.COLOURS). MOLLE: a carrier's molle lists its attach points (id; type mag, pistol, knife, radio, medical or utility; at = torso-local surface point in metres; face front, back, left or right). An attachable item names the point types it fits in attach. A pouch holds what accepts lists (item ids, type:x, tag:x; anything when absent) up to max_units and/or capacity_l litres (items of up to max_item_l each). People (PeopleLayer): zip cuffs take cuff_s to put on; intel items (type intel) carry an intel kind and a proposed intel_value, and each piece found gets its own intel_id in its state. Every item has desc (one or two plain sentences: what it is) and uses (short lines: what it is for and how to use it in this game, from the code), shown in-game by ItemInfo (Captain, 2026-10-14). Rarity: stats.rarity (common, uncommon, rare or very_rare) = how often it turns up in the loot tables (data/loot_tables.json: the commonest tier of any table that holds it; an item found nowhere gets a price band), shown by ItemInfo; none on mission objects and actions (Captain, 2026-10-20). Consumables (type consumable, Consumables): consume = {drug (a WoundModel.DRUGS id: caffeine, ibuprofen, paracetamol, water, ration), doses} or {battery: true} (a fresh NVG battery). Barter (type barter): found and sold, no use yet. Salvage counts as material for rebel upgrades; workshop_credit = dollars it takes off a motor pool repair from the stash. Concealment: conceal_mult = how much longer the enemy takes to spot you prone or crouched while you carry it. Shotguns: pellet_spread_deg = the cone each buckshot pellet leaves in round its shot.

uses: Goes in a heavy carrier's left or right side pocket
Stops rifle rounds up to III++ from the side
Steel: takes several hits in one spot; a stop can throw spall

items.name: Single M4 Mag Pouch
items.desc: A single rifle magazine pouch for MOLLE.
uses: Attach to a mag or utility MOLLE point (inventory, MOLLE view)
Holds one 5.56 or 7.62 magazine
Reloads pull from mag pouches first

items.name: Double M4 Mag Pouch
items.desc: A double rifle magazine pouch for MOLLE.
uses: Attach to a mag MOLLE point (inventory, MOLLE view)
Holds two 5.56 or 7.62 magazines
Reloads pull from mag pouches first

items.name: Double Pistol Mag Pouch
items.desc: A double pistol magazine pouch for MOLLE.
uses: Attach to a pistol, mag or utility MOLLE point (inventory, MOLLE view)
Holds two pistol magazines; pistol reloads pull from it first

items.name: Radio Pouch
items.desc: A radio pouch for MOLLE.
uses: Attach to a radio MOLLE point (inventory, MOLLE view)
Holds one AN/PRC-152 radio

items.name: Binocular Pouch
items.desc: A binocular pouch for MOLLE.
uses: Attach to a chest or utility MOLLE point (inventory, MOLLE view)
Holds one pair of binoculars

items.name: Utility Pouch (GP)
items.desc: A general-purpose utility pouch for MOLLE.
uses: Attach to a utility or chest MOLLE point (inventory, MOLLE view)
Holds 1.2 L of anything small (items up to 1 L each)

items.name: Sustainment Pouch
items.desc: A large sustainment pouch for MOLLE.
uses: Attach to a utility MOLLE point (inventory, MOLLE view)
Holds 2 L of anything small (items up to 1 L each)

items.name: IFAK Pouch
items.desc: A pouch for your individual first aid kit.
uses: Attach to a medical, utility or chest MOLLE point (inventory, MOLLE view)
Holds 1 L of medical items; treatments draw from it

items.name: Aid Bag (M9-style)
items.desc: A medic's aid bag that hangs on the back of a pack.
uses: Attach to a backpack's aid bag point (inventory, MOLLE view)
Holds 12 L of medical items; treatments draw from it

items.name: Tourniquet Holder
items.desc: A tourniquet holder for MOLLE, so a tourniquet is always at hand.
uses: Attach to a tourniquet, medical or utility MOLLE point (inventory, MOLLE view)
Holds one tourniquet

items.name: Grenade Pouch
items.desc: A single grenade pouch for MOLLE.
uses: Attach to a chest, mag or utility MOLLE point (inventory, MOLLE view)
Holds one grenade, smoke or flashbang

items.name: Fixed-Blade Knife
items.desc: A fixed-blade knife in its sheath.
uses: Attach to a knife or utility MOLLE point (inventory, MOLLE view)
Carried gear: there is no knife attack yet

items.name: Entrenching Tool
items.desc: A folding shovel: dig a dirt fighting position wherever you stand.
uses: Left Ctrl + Left Alt (yourself) > Dig a fighting position: kneel 20 s and a dirt berm rises in front of you
Stay put while you dig: moving off it stops
The berm stops rounds; blasts wear it down (three flatten it)
It takes the colour of the ground you dig it from

items.name: Counter-drone Jammer
items.desc: A man-portable counter-drone jammer: an enemy recon drone within 150 m of whoever carries it loses its link and falls.
uses: Carry it anywhere (a pouch, the pack): it works while its carrier is up
Any of the squad carrying one counts (a player or squad AI)
Allied quartermasters sell it from Trusted

items.name: AN/PRC-152 Radio
items.desc: An AN/PRC-152 field radio: your squad's link to employers.
uses: In a hot zone, Left Ctrl + Left Alt (yourself) > More > Radio for a contract: a new contract comes in and is taken on the spot
Anyone in the squad carrying one counts (a player or squad AI)
Fits the radio pouch

items.name: Enemy Handheld Radio
items.desc: A handheld radio taken off an enemy: it listens to their net.
uses: Carry it (anywhere in your kit) and the squad hears enemy chatter: reports, the zone standing to, QRFs setting out
Once the enemy finds a body or misses a check-in they change frequency a few minutes later and it goes quiet; another radio taken after that listens again
Can't call your employer: it doesn't count for radio contracts

items.name: Binoculars
items.desc: 7x binoculars for watching ground from a distance.
uses: B (on foot) raises them: a 7x view with a mil scale, the weapon lowered; B again, sprinting or a weapon key lowers them
Squad AI carrying them spots distant enemies sooner while out of contact
Fits the binocular pouch

items.name: Assault Pack (24 L)
items.desc: A 24 L assault pack for a day's kit.
uses: Backpack slot: adds 24 L of storage
Comes off with what's in it; empty, it rolls up to 1.5 L to stow
One pack-top point for a disposable launcher and an aid bag point (inventory, MOLLE view)

items.name: Ruck (45 L)
items.desc: A 45 L rucksack for long patrols and extra ammunition.
uses: Backpack slot: adds 45 L of storage
Comes off with what's in it; empty, it rolls up to 2.5 L to stow
Three pack-top points for disposable launchers and an aid bag point (inventory, MOLLE view)

items.name: IFAK
items.desc: An individual first aid kit: a tourniquet, two pressure bandages, hemostatic gauze and a chest seal.
uses: Treatments draw from loose items first, then from the kit; the medical menu lists what's inside
An opened kit keeps what's left
Fits the IFAK pouch

items.name: Trauma Kit
items.desc: A larger trauma kit: 2 tourniquets, 4 bandages, 2 gauze, 2 chest seals, a splint, 2 morphine and an NPA.
uses: Treatments draw from loose items first, then from the kit; the medical menu lists what's inside
An opened kit keeps what's left

items.name: Tourniquet
items.desc: A windlass tourniquet: the first thing on a massive limb bleed.
uses: Stops an arterial bleed on an arm or leg: put it on that segment (it holds everything below it)
H opens the medical menu (on who you look at, else yourself); or Left Ctrl > Treat
About 4 s (6 s on yourself); a rushed one (1.5 s, and always under fire) lets 30% through: a second beside it fixes that; two at most per segment
It hurts while on, and one on a leg makes you limp
Remove tourniquet (3 s) once the wound is packed with gauze; it goes back in your kit

items.name: Pressure Bandage
items.desc: An elastic pressure bandage for ordinary bleeding wounds.
uses: Treats venous bleeds, muscle wounds and grazes, and the bleed of an open fracture, on any body part
H opens the medical menu (on who you look at, else yourself); or Left Ctrl > Treat
About 5 s

items.name: Hemostatic Gauze
items.desc: Gauze that clots blood, packed into a deep wound.
uses: Packs junctional bleeds (neck, armpit, groin) and arterial bleeds where a tourniquet can't go, or one already under a tourniquet so it can come off
Also stops an open fracture's bleed
H opens the medical menu (on who you look at, else yourself); or Left Ctrl > Treat
About 8 s; on a limb's arterial bleed put a tourniquet on first

items.name: Vented Chest Seal
items.desc: A vented seal for an open chest wound.
uses: Seals an open chest wound on the chest; sealed in time, no tension pneumothorax starts and the lung re-expands over about 2 minutes
H opens the medical menu (on who you look at, else yourself); or Left Ctrl > Treat
About 5 s

items.name: Splint
items.desc: A malleable splint for broken bones.
uses: Treats a broken arm, hand or leg, and a broken collarbone (as a sling); not the pelvis
Eases the fracture's pain; walking and jogging come back, sprinting doesn't
H opens the medical menu (on who you look at, else yourself); or Left Ctrl > Treat
About 8 s

items.name: Pelvic Binder
items.desc: A pelvic sling for a broken pelvis.
uses: Treats a broken pelvis: cuts its internal bleeding to a fifth and eases the pain
The casualty still can't stand or walk until the mission ends (crawl or be carried)
H opens the medical menu (on who you look at, else yourself); or Left Ctrl > Treat
About 10 s

items.name: Morphine Autoinjector
items.desc: A morphine autoinjector for pain.
uses: Eases pain and treats a cracked rib (its only fix)
H opens the medical menu (on who you look at, else yourself); or Left Ctrl > Treat
About 2 s; works in over 30 s and wears off slowly (half every 12 minutes)
Too much sedates (about 2.5 doses in the blood) and past 3 slows breathing, which can stop the heart
No use in cardiac arrest

items.name: NPA Airway
items.desc: A nasopharyngeal airway: a soft tube that keeps an unconscious casualty's airway open.
uses: Clears and keeps open the airway of an unconscious casualty (head) so oxygen recovers
Not for someone awake
H opens the medical menu (on who you look at, else yourself); or Left Ctrl > Treat
About 3 s

items.name: IV Catheter (10G)
items.desc: A 10 gauge IV catheter: a big bore for fast fluids.
uses: Gives IV access in a forearm or lower leg (not below a tourniquet) for fluid bags
Someone else has to place it; one line at a time
About 22 s; 5x the 18G flow; bigger bores hurt more
In shock (a quarter of the blood lost) it takes longer and can miss the vein (the catheter is used up)

items.name: IV Catheter (12G)
items.desc: A 12 gauge IV catheter: a big bore for fast fluids.
uses: Gives IV access in a forearm or lower leg (not below a tourniquet) for fluid bags
Someone else has to place it; one line at a time
About 18 s; 4x the 18G flow; bigger bores hurt more
In shock (a quarter of the blood lost) it takes longer and can miss the vein (the catheter is used up)

items.name: IV Catheter (14G)
items.desc: A 14 gauge IV catheter.
uses: Gives IV access in a forearm or lower leg (not below a tourniquet) for fluid bags
Someone else has to place it; one line at a time
About 15 s; 3x the 18G flow; bigger bores hurt more
In shock (a quarter of the blood lost) it takes longer and can miss the vein (the catheter is used up)

items.name: IV Catheter (16G)
items.desc: A 16 gauge IV catheter.
uses: Gives IV access in a forearm or lower leg (not below a tourniquet) for fluid bags
Someone else has to place it; one line at a time
About 12 s; 2x the 18G flow; bigger bores hurt more
In shock (a quarter of the blood lost) it takes longer and can miss the vein (the catheter is used up)

items.name: IV Catheter (18G)
items.desc: A 18 gauge IV catheter: the everyday size.
uses: Gives IV access in a forearm or lower leg (not below a tourniquet) for fluid bags
Someone else has to place it; one line at a time
About 10 s; the standard flow; bigger bores hurt more
In shock (a quarter of the blood lost) it takes longer and can miss the vein (the catheter is used up)

items.name: IV Catheter (20G)
items.desc: A 20 gauge IV catheter: small and gentle.
uses: Gives IV access in a forearm or lower leg (not below a tourniquet) for fluid bags
Someone else has to place it; one line at a time
About 8 s; 0.6x the 18G flow; bigger bores hurt more
In shock (a quarter of the blood lost) it takes longer and can miss the vein (the catheter is used up)

items.name: IO Kit (Sternal)
items.desc: A sternal intraosseous kit: a line into the breastbone when veins won't do.
uses: Gives IV/IO access in the sternum (chest) for fluid bags; always goes in, even in deep shock or with tourniquets on every limb
Someone else has to place it
About 5 s; flows like an 18G IV, twice that under a pressure bag

items.name: Saline (250 mL)
items.desc: A 250 mL bag of saline.
uses: Replaces lost blood volume through an IV or IO line already in; one bag runs at a time
H opens the medical menu (on who you look at, else yourself); or Left Ctrl > Treat
About 3 s to hang; runs in about 165 s through an 18G (faster through a bigger bore)

items.name: Saline (500 mL)
items.desc: A 500 mL bag of saline.
uses: Replaces lost blood volume through an IV or IO line already in; one bag runs at a time
H opens the medical menu (on who you look at, else yourself); or Left Ctrl > Treat
About 3 s to hang; runs in about 270 s through an 18G

items.name: Saline (1000 mL)
items.desc: A 1000 mL bag of saline.
uses: Replaces lost blood volume through an IV or IO line already in; one bag runs at a time
H opens the medical menu (on who you look at, else yourself); or Left Ctrl > Treat
About 3 s to hang; runs in about 450 s through an 18G

items.name: Blood (250 mL)
items.desc: A 250 mL unit of blood.
uses: Replaces lost blood through an IV or IO line already in (works like saline here); one bag runs at a time
H opens the medical menu (on who you look at, else yourself); or Left Ctrl > Treat
About 3 s to hang; runs in about 165 s through an 18G

items.name: Blood (500 mL)
items.desc: A 500 mL unit of blood.
uses: Replaces lost blood through an IV or IO line already in (works like saline here); one bag runs at a time
H opens the medical menu (on who you look at, else yourself); or Left Ctrl > Treat
About 3 s to hang; runs in about 270 s through an 18G

items.name: Blood (1000 mL)
items.desc: A 1000 mL unit of blood.
uses: Replaces lost blood through an IV or IO line already in (works like saline here); one bag runs at a time
H opens the medical menu (on who you look at, else yourself); or Left Ctrl > Treat
About 3 s to hang; runs in about 450 s through an 18G

items.name: Pressure Bag
items.desc: A pressure cuff that squeezes a fluid bag to run it faster.
uses: Goes on an IV or IO line already in: doubles an IO's flow and keeps fluids running when veins have collapsed (37% of blood lost)
H opens the medical menu (on who you look at, else yourself); or Left Ctrl > Treat
About 3 s

items.name: Decompression Needle
items.desc: A long needle to let trapped air out of the chest.
uses: Treats a tension pneumothorax (chest): stops the cardiac arrest it was heading for
The lung stays partly collapsed until the wound is sealed
H opens the medical menu (on who you look at, else yourself); or Left Ctrl > Treat
About 5 s; a little pain

items.name: Pulse Oximeter
items.desc: A fingertip pulse oximeter.
uses: Carry it (loose or in a kit): Check condition and the medical menu then read the casualty's SpO2 and pulse as numbers
Nothing to apply: it only measures

items.name: Epinephrine Autoinjector
items.desc: An epinephrine (adrenaline) autoinjector.
uses: In cardiac arrest, once blood is back over 60%: improves each CPR cycle's and defibrillator shock's chance to restart the heart
On someone knocked out with no other cause left: a 50% chance they come round in seconds
Raises the heart rate
H opens the medical menu (on who you look at, else yourself); or Left Ctrl > Treat
About 2 s

items.name: Atropine Autoinjector
items.desc: An atropine autoinjector to speed up a slow heart.
uses: Treats a slow heart (under 45 bpm): raises the heart rate about 30 bpm per dose
A heart too slow for a minute stops
H opens the medical menu (on who you look at, else yourself); or Left Ctrl > Treat
About 2 s

items.name: Adenosine Syringe
items.desc: An adenosine syringe to slow a racing heart.
uses: Treats a racing heart (over 150 bpm): lowers the heart rate about 40 bpm per dose
A heart racing too fast for a minute stops
H opens the medical menu (on who you look at, else yourself); or Left Ctrl > Treat
About 2 s

items.name: Defibrillator (AED)
items.desc: An automated external defibrillator (AED).
uses: Shocks a heart in cardiac arrest: about a 35% chance per shock to restart it (more with epinephrine in)
Does nothing until blood is back over 60%: get fluids in first
Someone else has to use it; among squad AI only medics do
About 5 s a shock; reusable

items.name: CPR
items.desc: Chest compressions and rescue breaths: no kit needed.
uses: For cardiac arrest: each 10 s cycle has a small chance (8%) to restart the heart, more with epinephrine in
Does nothing until blood is back over 60%
Someone else has to do it; among squad AI only medics do
Listed in the medical menu for anyone with no item

items.name: Hemostat Clamp (Surgery Kit)
items.desc: A hemostat clamp from a surgery kit.
uses: Clamps internal (torso) bleeding, the only fix for it in the field; also junctional and arterial bleeds
Or closes an open chest wound instead of a seal (it can reopen when the casualty sprints or jumps)
About 20 s; players and medics only (other squad AI won't)

items.name: Surgery Kit (2 uses)
items.desc: A field surgery kit with two hemostat clamps.
uses: Each use is a clamp: for internal (torso) bleeding, junctional and arterial bleeds, or closing a chest wound
About 20 s a use; players and medics only
Treatments draw from loose items first, then from the kit

items.name: Surgery Kit (3 uses)
items.desc: A field surgery kit with three hemostat clamps.
uses: Each use is a clamp: for internal (torso) bleeding, junctional and arterial bleeds, or closing a chest wound
About 20 s a use; players and medics only
Treatments draw from loose items first, then from the kit

items.name: Surgery Kit (5 uses)
items.desc: A field surgery kit with five hemostat clamps.
uses: Each use is a clamp: for internal (torso) bleeding, junctional and arterial bleeds, or closing a chest wound
About 20 s a use; players and medics only
Treatments draw from loose items first, then from the kit

items.name: Burn Dressing
items.desc: A gel dressing for burns.
uses: Treats burns: each dressing eases burn pain, one per tenth of the body burned
H opens the medical menu (on who you look at, else yourself); or Left Ctrl > Treat
About 5 s

items.name: Hypothermia Blanket
items.desc: A heat-reflective blanket.
uses: Treats hypothermia: a casualty who lost 30% of their blood and lay still for 5 minutes bleeds 25% faster until wrapped
H opens the medical menu (on who you look at, else yourself); or Left Ctrl > Treat
About 5 s

items.name: Electronic Ear Protection
items.desc: Electronic ear protection: lets voices through, blocks loud noise.
uses: Works from anywhere in your kit (no slot needed)
Stops deafness from flashbangs and from gunfire indoors
Halves how long a blast deafens you

items.name: Frag Grenade
items.desc: A fragmentation hand grenade with a 3.5 s fuse.
uses: G takes the picked grenade in hand (nothing thrown); Fire throws, Aim lobs, G again puts it away; Shift+G cycles types
Blast within 5 m (10 m indoors): deafness, concussion, burns up close
Fragments wound within 8 m, 3 to 8 wounds up close; walls and armour shield
Craters voxel walls; fits the grenade pouch

items.name: Smoke Grenade
items.desc: A white smoke grenade: a screen that hides you.
uses: Pick it with Shift+G, G takes it in hand, Fire throws, Aim lobs, G puts it away (smokes show in the cycle only while you carry one)
Pops after 1.5 s: the cloud blocks AI line of sight and the view
Fits the grenade pouch

items.name: Smoke Grenade (Green)
items.desc: A green smoke grenade for screening and marking.
uses: Pick it with Shift+G, G takes it in hand, Fire throws, Aim lobs, G puts it away
Pops after 1.5 s: green cloud that blocks AI line of sight and the view
Fits the grenade pouch

items.name: Smoke Grenade (Yellow)
items.desc: A yellow smoke grenade for screening and marking.
uses: Pick it with Shift+G, G takes it in hand, Fire throws, Aim lobs, G puts it away
Pops after 1.5 s: yellow cloud that blocks AI line of sight and the view
Fits the grenade pouch

items.name: Smoke Grenade (Blue)
items.desc: A blue smoke grenade for screening and marking.
uses: Pick it with Shift+G, G takes it in hand, Fire throws, Aim lobs, G puts it away
Pops after 1.5 s: blue cloud that blocks AI line of sight and the view
Fits the grenade pouch

items.name: Smoke Grenade (Purple)
items.desc: A purple smoke grenade for screening and marking.
uses: Pick it with Shift+G, G takes it in hand, Fire throws, Aim lobs, G puts it away
Pops after 1.5 s: purple cloud that blocks AI line of sight and the view
Fits the grenade pouch

items.name: Flashbang
items.desc: A stun grenade: a blinding flash and a deafening bang, no fragments.
uses: Pick it with Shift+G, G takes it in hand, Fire throws, Aim lobs, G puts it away; goes off after 1.5 s
Blinds players by how close they are and whether they faced it; stuns AI soldiers
Deafens everyone close for 3 to 6 s (ear protection stops that)
Fits the grenade pouch

items.name: Breaching Charge
items.desc: A 2 kg demolition block for breaching walls and destroying objectives.
uses: Pick it with Shift+G, then G shows where it goes on the surface you look at (within 2.5 m); Fire places it, G or right mouse puts it away
Goes off after the fuse (about 10 s): a blast and a breach carved in the wall
Destroys caches and AA sites when placed by them
Sticks to what it's on, vehicles and people included

items.name: Electronics Salvage
items.desc: Salvaged electronics: radios, boards and wiring worth money to the company.
uses: Carry it out and it goes to the company stash
Left in the field it counts toward the debrief's salvage pool
Salvaging a vehicle wreck yields some

items.name: M2HB (gun, packed)
items.desc: The M2 .50 machine gun off its tripod, receiver and barrel: one man's load.
uses: Heavy: 38 kg, carried in both hands; the tripod is a second man's load
With the M3 tripod within 3 m (a squadmate's hands or the ground): Left Ctrl + Left Alt (yourself) > Set up the gun, 20 s, holding still
At a set-up gun with nobody on it: Pack up the gun, 15 s

items.name: M3 Tripod (packed)
items.desc: The M2's folding tripod with its traversing and elevating gear.
uses: Heavy: 20 kg, carried in both hands
Set up with the M2's gun within 3 m: Left Ctrl + Left Alt (yourself) > Set up the gun

items.name: 60 mm Mortar Round (HE)
items.desc: A 60 mm high-explosive mortar round for the M224.
uses: Carry it, or load it into the mortar's hold
At the mortar: Lay and fire (firing table) fires one, from the hold or your kit

items.name: 82 mm Mortar Round (HE)
items.desc: An 82 mm high-explosive mortar round for the 2B14.
uses: At the mortar: Lay and fire (firing table) fires one, from the hold or your kit

items.name: M224 Tube (packed)
items.desc: The M224 60 mm mortar's tube and sight: one man's load.
uses: 9 kg, carried in both hands; the bipod and baseplate are a second man's load
With the mount within 3 m: Left Ctrl + Left Alt (yourself) > Set up the gun, 20 s

items.name: M224 Bipod and Baseplate (packed)
items.desc: The M224's bipod and baseplate.
uses: 12 kg, carried in both hands
Set up with the tube within 3 m

items.name: 2B14 Tube (packed)
items.desc: The 2B14 82 mm mortar's tube.
uses: 14 kg; the bipod and the baseplate are two more men's loads

items.name: 2B14 Bipod (packed)
items.desc: The 2B14's bipod and sight.
uses: 13 kg

items.name: 2B14 Baseplate (packed)
items.desc: The 2B14's round baseplate.
uses: 15 kg

items.name: DShK (gun, packed)
items.desc: A DShK 12.7 mm machine gun off its mount: one man's load.
uses: Heavy: 34 kg, carried in both hands; the mount is a second man's load
With the mount within 3 m: Left Ctrl + Left Alt (yourself) > Set up the gun, 20 s

items.name: DShK Tripod (packed)
items.desc: The DShK's heavy tripod mount.
uses: Heavy: 30 kg, carried in both hands
Set up with the DShK's gun within 3 m: Left Ctrl + Left Alt (yourself) > Set up the gun

items.name: HVT Hard Case
items.desc: A locked hard case a contract may want brought out.
uses: Bulky: carried in both hands (Left Ctrl > Pick up); no room in packs
Left Ctrl + Left Alt (yourself) > Drop held item sets it down
Bring it to extraction when a contract asks for it

items.name: ID Papers (proof)
items.desc: A target's identity papers, taken off his body: the client's proof of the kill.
uses: Search a killed HVT's body for it (Left Ctrl on the body > Loot)
Carry it out at extraction: an HVT kill pays in full only with it

items.name: Flight Recorder
items.desc: A downed aircraft's flight recorder (the black box) in its armoured case, still bolted to a piece of its rack.
uses: Heavy: carried in both hands (Left Ctrl > Pick up); no room in packs
Left Ctrl + Left Alt (yourself) > Drop held item sets it down
Bring it to extraction when a crash site contract asks for it

items.name: Crew ID Tags
items.desc: The identity tags of a downed aircraft's crew, gathered at the wreck.
uses: Pick them up at the crash site (Left Ctrl > Pick up)
Carry them out at extraction: a crash site contract pays a bonus for them

items.name: Supply Crate
items.desc: A crate of supplies, too big for any pack.
uses: Bulky: carried in both hands (Left Ctrl > Pick up)
Can be loaded into a vehicle's hold
Left Ctrl + Left Alt (yourself) > Drop held item sets it down

items.name: Supply Pallet
items.desc: A loaded supply pallet: a vehicle load, not a pack load.
uses: Bulky: carried in both hands (Left Ctrl > Pick up)
A vehicle can take it in its hold if there is room

items.name: Zip Cuffs
items.desc: Plastic restraints for detaining people.
uses: Left Ctrl on a person > Zip-cuff: takes 3 s and uses one
Works from behind, or once they give up or are down; an armed hostile who sees you coming can't be cuffed
Moving or being interrupted stops it

items.name: Laptop (intel)
items.desc: An enemy laptop: the most valuable intel you can find.
uses: Found on people (Left Ctrl > Search for intel) or where a mission places it
Carry it out: at the debrief turn it in for a lead (a new, better-informed contract) or sell it to a faction
Worth about $3,000

items.name: Phone (intel)
items.desc: An enemy phone holding contacts and messages.
uses: Found on people (Left Ctrl > Search for intel) or where a mission places it
Carry it out: at the debrief turn it in for a lead or sell it to a faction
Worth about $1,200

items.name: Documents (intel)
items.desc: Papers taken from the enemy: orders, lists, maps.
uses: Found on people (Left Ctrl > Search for intel) or where a mission places it
Carry it out: at the debrief turn it in for a lead or sell it to a faction
Worth about $800

items.name: USB Drive (intel)
items.desc: A memory stick off an enemy or found where a mission places it: files worth something to a buyer.
uses: Found on people (Left Ctrl > Search for intel) or where a mission places it
Carry it out: at the debrief turn it in for a lead or sell it to a faction
Worth about $600

items.name: Ledger (intel)
items.desc: A handwritten account book: payments, names and dates, worth more than a phone's contacts.
uses: Found on people (Left Ctrl > Search for intel) or where a mission places it
Carry it out: at the debrief turn it in for a lead or sell it to a faction
Worth about $1,800

items.name: Smuggled Cigarettes
items.desc: A carton crate of untaxed cigarettes, the smugglers' bread and butter.
uses: Contraband: found at checkpoints, compounds and HQs
A shady fixer (Mama Rook) pays full price and thinks better of the company
Sold at the base it fetches 40%, and lawful employers think less of the company
Worth about $300

items.name: Captagon Pills
items.desc: A bag of captagon tablets: the militias' fuel and their cash crop.
uses: Contraband: found at checkpoints, compounds and HQs
A shady fixer (Mama Rook) pays full price and thinks better of the company
Sold at the base it fetches 40%, and lawful employers think less of the company
Worth about $2,500

items.name: Counterfeit Dollars
items.desc: Bundles of good fake hundreds, not good enough for a bank.
uses: Contraband: found at checkpoints, compounds and HQs
A shady fixer (Mama Rook) pays full price and thinks better of the company
